chapters.label: Frankfurt
chapters.text: Frankfurt, 2011, the World Cup final. Japan, in blue, are losing to the USA, in white. Three minutes left. Corner! Homare Sawa sprints to the near post... goal!

chapters.label: Outside of the foot
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Sawa gets there first and flicks it with the outside of her right foot, over Hope Solo.

chapters.label: Two all
chapters.text: From behind, see it clip Abby Wambach into the net. Two all! Japan won the shootout, and Sawa won the Golden Ball and Golden Boot.

chapters.label: Near post
chapters.text: Attack the near post early, and use any part of your foot to redirect the ball.
